thread:
Maria: Peaches decided the balcony is officially hers. Dropped a pic — naps, dramatic ear flops, and a suspiciously intact basil leaf. 😼🌿
Jake: omg the ear flop is a whole mood. send more pics pls 😍
Sophie: why is she on the railing? that plant stand is treacherous. do we need a tiny harness? :laughing:
Maria: she’s very proud. also 0% interested in the harness, 100% interested in the sunbeam. photo: https://files.redwood-internal/pets/peaches_balcony_1.jpg
Liam: can confirm, basil survived. for now. recommend moving the pot into a safer corner unless you want pesto-flavored nap time. 😂
Maria: noted. the balcony has been declared 'No Human Traffic 8-10am' unless accompanied by tuna. @Sophie you were warned. :point_up:
Sophie: I volunteer for tuna escort duty. might also bring tiny sunglasses. :sunglasses: :fish:
PlantBot: reminder — balcony plants are on the automated watering schedule at 9:00. If Paeches (sic) sits directly on top of the saucer it will overflow. Setting temporary hold for today.
Maria: thanks PlantBot! saving lives (and basil). :raised_hands:
Jake: poll: is Peaches a nap model or a plant guardian? react with :heart: for nap, :seedling: for guardian, :eyes: for both
Sophie: voted :heart: but honestly she does a good plant-sitting pose.
Liam: :seedling: — she looks judgey about our window watering technique.
Maria: update: also found a tiny leaf in her whiskers. cat tax incoming. https://files.redwood-internal/pets/peaches_whisker_leaf.jpg
Jake: that leaf is a fashion statement. runway: balcony. :catwalk:
Sophie: okay that's my break, thanks for the serotonin everyone. :sparkles:
